label: 2. Allow me to make a quick report.

lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 107310108 · After Temporary Briefing Room chat 1. Rapi has invited {AccountData.NickName} to joi…

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Allow me to make a quick report.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Everyone in the Outpost has been informed of the situation.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Just as before, some of those who couldn't understand,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: such as Jackal and Drake, threw a fit.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I felt it would be unwise to invite them into this group,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: so I handled the situation myself and tried my best to explain, which placated them for now.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Thank you for helping.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: That's something we should have done ourselves.
Nicely done, Rapi.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: No worries.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Any progress on finding a Splendamin replacement?
No...

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: It's proving to be as difficult as we expected.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Makes sense.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: If a replacement could be found so easily,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Splendamin would have gone by the wayside long ago.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: There are so many conditions that need to be met.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: It'll be some time before we find something that fulfills all those requirements.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Doesn't sound easy.
Still, we have to keep going.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'm rooting for you.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Have you run into any dangerous situations out there?
Not really.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: That's a relief.
Oh, wait! There was one.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Oh? What is it?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: What are you talking about, Mr. Gourmand? We haven't run into any danger.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Yeah, that's right.
The meals Crust packed are so delicious that I might get addicted.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: For goodness sake.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: You're up on the surface right now.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: It's a place where anything could happen.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Please be more careful with your words,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: in order to avoid any misunderstandings.
... Sorry about that.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Don't worry, Rapi.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: We'll be protecting the Commander

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: and ensuring nothing happens to him.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: We're also making sure all his meals are taken care of.
They really are mouthwateringly delicious.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Very good. Thank you.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Take care of him and get him back safe.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: We certainly will.
